title: Investigation of Beige Fat Biology and Metabolism Using the CRISPR SunTag-p65-HSF1 Activation System
protocol: Design sgRNAs for CRISPR activation using CHOPCHOP or a similar tool.
Use the parameters Target: Prdm16, In: Mus musculus, Using: Crispr/Cas9, For: Activation.
Add overhangs to the sgRNA to match the SacI restriction site in the vector backbone pAAV-U6-gRNA-CBh-mCherry.
Include 5'- (N20)AGCT-3' sequence for the sgRNA.
Obtain the 3' sgRNA reverse complement sequence using a nucleotide sequence analysis tool.
Add 1 µL of each 5' and 3' single-stranded oligonucleotide (stock concentration: 100 µM) to the reaction mixture.
Add 1 µL of T4 ligase buffer to the reaction mixture.
Add 0.5 µL of T4 polynucleotide kinase (PNK) (1 × 10^4 units/mL) to the reaction mixture.
Add 6.5 µL of H2O to a final reaction volume of 10 µL.
Anneal complementary single-stranded oligonucleotides at 37 °C for 30 min using a thermocycler.
Anneal complementary single-stranded oligonucleotides at 95 °C for 5 min using a thermocycler.
Ramp down the temperature from 95 °C to room temperature at a rate of 5 °C/min using a thermocycler.
Add 25 ng of plasmid pAAV-U6-gRNA-CBh-mCherry to 2 µL of annealed sgRNA oligonucleotides.
Add 1 µL of SacI enzyme to the reaction mixture.
Add 2 µL of 10x T4 DNA ligase buffer to the reaction mixture.
Add 1 µL of T4 DNA ligase (1-3 u/µL) to the reaction mixture.
Adjust the final reaction volume to 10 µL with H2O.
Incubate the reaction mixture at 37 °C for 5 min using a thermocycler.
Incubate the reaction mixture at 25 °C for 5 min using a thermocycler.
Repeat steps of incubating the reaction mixture at 37 °C and then 25 °C for 15 cycles in total.
Hold the reaction mixture at 4 °C after ligation cycles.
Transform competent E. coli DH10B cells with 4 μL of the ligation product using heat shock (42 °C for 45 s).
Spread transformed cells on an agar plate containing 100 μg/mL ampicillin.
Confirm transformed colonies by colony PCR.
Pick a colony and mix with 5 μL of master mix, 0.1 μL of universal primer, 0.1 μL of sgRNA reverse primer, and 5 μL of H2O.
Run the PCR using a thermocycler under initial denaturation (94 °C for 2 min).
Followed by 35 cycles of denaturation (94 °C for 20 s), annealing (60 °C for 30 s), and extension (72 °C for 30 s).
Conclude with a final elongation step (72 °C for 5 min).
Resolve the DNA using agarose (1.5%) gel electrophoresis in 0.5x TAE buffer at 90 V for 30 min.
Submit positive samples for Sanger sequencing using universal primer.
Purify the plasmid from a positive clone using a plasmid purification kit, following the manufacturer's instructions.
Incubate the positive clone (12 h at 37 °C with shaking at 200 rpm) in a standard bacterial growth medium containing 100 μg/mL ampicillin.
Centrifuge bacterial cells at 6,000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C.
Plate 293T cells in a 175 cm² flask using DMEM containing 10% FBS and 1% P/S.
Incubate flasks at 37 °C, 5% CO₂, and 95% humidity until cells reach 50%-70% confluence.
Mix 14 µL of polyethylenimine with 1 mL of 150 mM NaCl.
Mix pAdDeltaF6 (17.7 µg), AAV2/8 (7.9 µg), and cloned sgRNA (5.9 µg) in 1 mL of 150 mM NaCl.
Transfer polyethylenimine:NaCl mixture drop by drop to the tube containing DNA.
Incubate the DNA-polyethylenimine mixture for 20 min at 25 °C.
Replace cell growth medium with DMEM containing 1% FBS and L-alanyl-L-glutamine (0.5 g/L).
Add 2 mL of polyethylenimine:DNA mixture to each culture flask.
Incubate cells in a CO₂ incubator at 37 °C, 5% CO₂, and 95% humidity.
Add 5 mL of DMEM supplemented with 10% FBS and L-alanyl-L-glutamine (0.5g/L).
Incubate for 3 days.
Detach cells from the culture flask using a cell scraper.
Collect 293T cells from 10 flasks into 50 mL conical tubes, adding DMEM to reach 30 mL per tube.
Add 3 mL of chloroform to each tube and mix with a vortex mixer at high speed for 5 min.
Resuspend the cells by adding 7.6 mL of 5 M NaCl and mixing briefly.
Centrifuge at 3,000 × g and 4 °C for 5 min.
Transfer the aqueous phase into a new conical tube.
Add 9.4 mL of 50% (v/v) PEG 8000 and mix with a vortex mixer at high speed for 10 s.
Put samples on ice for 1 h.
Centrifuge at 3,000 × g at 4 °C for 30 min.
Remove the supernatant and allow the pellet to dry for 10 min.
Add 1.4 mL of HEPES (50 mM, pH 8) and mix for 5 min using a vortex mixer at high speed.
Add 3.5 µL of 1 M MgCl2, 14 µL of DNase I (20 units/µL), and 1.4 µL of RNase A (10 µg/µL).
Incubate in a 37 °C water bath for 20 min.
Transfer the samples into new 1.5 mL tubes, adding 700 µL per tube.
Add 700 µL of chloroform to each tube and mix using a vortex mixer at high speed for 10 s.
Centrifuge at 3,000 × g at 4 °C for 5 min.
Transfer the aqueous phase to a new tube.
Repeat this step 3x.
Evaporate chloroform for 30 min in a biosafety cabinet.
Transfer 300 µL of the aqueous phase into a 0.5 mL ultra-centrifugation tube.
Spin the filter at 14,000 × g at 25 °C for 5 min.
Remove the flow-through and spin the filter again until the entire volume has passed through the filter.
Add 300 µL of Dulbecco's phosphate-buffered saline (DPBS) to wash the filter.
Mix the solutions by pipetting.
Centrifuge the filter for 5 min at 14,000 × g at 25 °C.
Repeat the washing step 4 times.
Centrifuge the filter for 8 min at 14,000 × g at 25 °C.
Place the filter upside down into a new tube.
Spin for 2 min at 1,000 × g at 25 °C.
Prepare a standard curve for AAV titration according to Fripont et al.15.
Separate surgical tools and supplies needed for surgery.
Sterilize all materials as recommended for each specific material.
Anesthetize the mouse with 100 mg/kg ketamine and 10 mg/kg xylazine by intraperitoneal injection.
Confirm anesthesia by applying vigorous pressure on the paw and tail and checking for a reflex.
Apply ointment to the mouse's eyes to avoid eye dryness during surgery.
Place the anesthetized mouse in the supine position.
Shave a small area on the flanks, proximal to the hip joints for iWAT injections, with a shaver.
Apply depilatory cream for 5 min.
Remove residual cream with water to avoid skin burn.
Disinfect the skin using three alternating rounds of applying antiseptic solution (povidone-iodine) on the skin with a clean gauze.
Discard the gauze after each use.
Perform a final application of an antiseptic solution on the skin.
Make a 1-2 cm incision with sterilized scissors in the proximal area of the joints.
Hold the skin open using forceps to expose the fat depot.
Gently pull the fat depot upward to ensure the injection is at the correct location and depth.
Fill the microliter syringe with 2.5 µL (5.6 × 1010 viral genomes/µL) of AAV containing the sgRNA targeting the endogenous Prdm16 gene.
Insert the needle at a 30°-45° angle into the iWAT and inject.
Repeat the injection 5 times into different locations of the tissue to homogeneously infect the whole iWAT fat pad.
Close the shaved skin incision using 4/0 monofilament sutures.
Place the mouse on a heat pad until consciousness is regained.
Monitor the animal every 10-15 minutes until it fully recovers.
Observe the locomotor profiling for linearity and absence of distress or pain.
Administer tramadol hydrochloride (5 mg/kg) intraperitoneally for postoperative pain control within 48 hours after surgery, twice daily for 3 days.
Keep the mouse in a cage with free access to food and water during the healing period.
Proceed to euthanize the mouse after the healing period.
Administer an overdose of injectable anesthetics intraperitoneally from 3x the inducing dose (300-360 mg/kg ketamine hydrochloride + 10-40 mg/kg xylazine hydrochloride).
Perform decapitation to complete euthanasia.
Isolate and plate primary stromal vascular cells (SVFs) from the inguinal white adipose tissue (iWAT) of AdipoSPH mice according to Aune et al.
Seed SVF-derived cells into a 6-well plate containing complete medium for 1-2 hours.
Aspirate the medium from the well.
Wash the well twice with phosphate-buffered saline.
Replace the washed well with fresh complete medium.
Incubate the cells at 37 °C, 5% CO2, and 95% humidity until they reach 70%-80% confluency.
Treat the cells with induction medium to initiate differentiation on day 0.
Replace the induction medium with maintenance medium after 2 days (day 2).
Replace the maintenance medium with fresh maintenance medium after 2 more days (day 4).
Change the maintenance medium every 48 hours until preadipocytes are fully differentiated into adipocytes.
Transduce cells by mixing 5.6 × 10^10 VG/μL of AAV-carrying sgRNA-Prdm16 with 2 mL complete medium and hexadimethrine bromide (8 µg/mL).
Add the transduction mixture to the cells replacing their current medium.
Incubate transduced cells for 12 hours at 37 °C, 95% humidity, and 5% CO2.
Seed 4.0 × 10^4 cells per well with induction medium in a 24-well cell culture plate.
Perform the oxygen consumption assay when the cells reach 80%-100% confluence and are fully differentiated.
